description: Create a personal, auto-updating calendar feed for the given filters (or a list of event ids) and return one-click links for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook. Each call stores a new feed record (filters only, no personal data). Give the links to the user.

max_price_usd.description: Cheapest posted registration at or below this

query.description: Words to match in the name, organizer, city or description, e.g. "ICSC", "Las Vegas", "CMBS"

sectors.description: Any of these sector tags ("lending" = CRE finance)

state.description: US state code or country as listed, e.g. "NY", "TX", "France"

name: calendar_subscription_link
title: Make a calendar subscription
